about: What you're looking for. Tell your AI tool in your own words ("I want remote contract work as a design engineer, nothing in crypto") and it fills this in. Private: never published.
titles_about: Job titles to match, e.g. "product engineer", "design engineer". A listing's title must contain one of them. Empty matches every title.
remote_about: "required" (remote only), "preferred" (remote, or on-site in your locations), or "any".
must_have_about: Words a listing must mention (any one of them), e.g. "accessibility".
avoid_about: Words that rule a listing out, e.g. "crypto", "senior director".
companies_about: Companies to check every day. Each is { "name": "Vercel", "board": "greenhouse:vercel" }. The board is the provider and the last part of their careers page address: boards.greenhouse.io/<slug>, jobs.lever.co/<slug>, or jobs.ashbyhq.com/<slug>.
schedule_about: Optional. { "days": ["wednesday"], "time": "08:00", "ai_review": false }. Most new listings go up Monday to Wednesday. Without AI review a run uses no AI tokens.
